name: Stepping Stones Scrollbar
title: Stepping Stones Scrollbar
description: Custom page scrollbar made of tilted stones that darken as you pass them, fill as you read, mark section starts and accept click, drag and keys.
themeReviewed: Long text page with a fixed rail: surfaces follow the tokens; the automatic luminance probe mis-measures the tall section, checked by eye in a dark and a light theme on 2026-10-25.
